vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: creator-contract
Version: 1.0.0

The 'creator-contract' skill is a purely instructional markdown document (SKILL.md) designed to guide an AI agent in drafting influencer collaboration agreements. It contains no executable code, no requests for sensitive system access, and no malicious prompt injection attempts; it functions entirely as a template for generating legal-style text based on user inputs.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only drafting skill whose requests and behavior align with its stated purpose (generating ecommerce-focused creator collaboration contract drafts); it asks for no credentials, installs nothing, and does not overreach system access.

dimensions.detail: The name and description match the SKILL.md: the skill is explicitly a contract-drafting tool for creator collaborations and requests inputs (collaboration type, deliverables, compensation, usage rights, exclusivity, etc.) that are directly necessary to produce the described output.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only instructions to generate contract drafts and negotiation guidance based on user-provided inputs. It does not instruct the agent to read files, access environment variables, call external endpoints, or transmit data outside the agent. It clearly labels outputs as drafts and disclaims that the content is not a substitute for legal advice.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification or code files are present; this is instruction-only, so nothing is written to disk or downloaded during installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The inputs it asks the user to provide are appropriate for drafting a contract and proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable (defaults). It does not request persistent system presence or elevated privileges. Autonomous invocation is allowed by platform default but there are no other privilege-elevating flags or requests.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and limited to drafting contract text, but remember: (1) outputs are drafts, not legal advice—have a qualified attorney review any contract before use, especially for high-value deals or regulated categories; (2) don’t paste sensitive personal or financial data into the prompt (SSNs, bank account numbers, private tax IDs); (3) double-check jurisdiction, tax, and contractor-classification items locally; and (4) if you later connect contract text to downstream systems (signature services, CRM, ad accounts), review privacy and access controls for those integrations separately.
